_game: COOM: Parkour (Doom continual-RL suite; own scenario, not stock ViZDoom)
_note: Needs the TTomilin/COOM repo checked out somewhere and COOM_REPO set to it (or pass --coom-repo) -- the coom backend reads its conf.cfg/.wad scenario assets directly, it does not pip install the COOM package (which pins a conflicting gymnasium version).
_keys_note: The coom backend derives its own default keymap from the scenario's 4 buttons (always TURN_LEFT, TURN_RIGHT, MOVE_FORWARD, plus one scenario-specific button). For parkour that 4th button is JUMP -> SPACE.

text: Navigate the platforming course, jumping across
gaps and up ledges as you go.
